title: Creamy Indian Curry Sauce
description: A rich and creamy sauce infused with Indian spices, perfect as a dip or accompaniment to your favorite dishes. This sauce is easy to make and can be customized to your taste.
instructions: Heat the infused oil in a small saucepan over medium heat.
Add the curry powder and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the tahini, lemon juice, garlic, and ginger. Whisk until smooth.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
